name: ipv4
label: IPv4 address
description: Dotted quad IPv4 address.
author: matalog

name: ipv6
label: IPv6 address
description: IPv6 address, compressed forms included.
author: matalog

name: mac
label: MAC address
description: Six hex pairs separated by colons or dashes, or three dotted groups of four.
author: matalog

name: port
label: Network port
description: Integer 0 to 65535 in a field whose name ends in port.
author: matalog

name: cidr
label: CIDR block
description: IPv4 address with a prefix length.
author: matalog

name: hostname
label: Hostname
description: Single DNS label without dots, at least one letter.
author: matalog

name: domain
label: Domain name
description: Two or more DNS labels ending in an alphabetic top-level label that is not a file extension.
author: matalog

name: fqdn
label: Fully qualified domain name
description: Three or more DNS labels ending in an alphabetic top-level label that is not a file extension.
author: matalog

name: url
label: URL
description: Scheme followed by :// and a non-blank remainder.
author: matalog

name: email
label: Email address
description: Local part, @, domain with a dot.
author: matalog

name: username
label: Username
description: Login name: letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, at least one letter; shape only.
author: matalog

name: domain_user
label: Domain-qualified user
description: DOMAIN\user form.
author: matalog

name: windows_sid
label: Windows SID
description: Security identifier S-1-....
author: matalog

name: uuid
label: UUID
description: 8-4-4-4-12 hex groups.
author: matalog

name: aws_arn
label: AWS ARN
description: arn:partition:service:region:account:resource.
author: matalog

name: aws_account_id
label: AWS account id
description: Twelve decimal digits.
author: matalog

name: aws_access_key_id
label: AWS access key id
description: AKIA or ASIA followed by sixteen upper-case alphanumerics.
author: matalog

name: aws_region
label: AWS region
description: Region code such as us-east-1.
author: matalog

name: jwt
label: JSON web token
description: Three base64url segments separated by dots.
author: matalog

name: md5
label: MD5 hash
description: 32 hex characters.
author: matalog

name: sha1
label: SHA-1 hash
description: 40 hex characters.
author: matalog

name: sha256
label: SHA-256 hash
description: 64 hex characters.
author: matalog

name: sha512
label: SHA-512 hash
description: 128 hex characters.
author: matalog

name: epoch_seconds
label: Epoch seconds
description: Unix time in seconds, 2001 to 2286, optional fraction, in a time-named field.
author: matalog

name: epoch_millis
label: Epoch milliseconds
description: Unix time in milliseconds, 2001 to 2286, in a time-named field.
author: matalog

name: iso8601
label: ISO 8601 timestamp
description: Date, T, time, optional fraction and zone.
author: matalog

name: rfc3339_date
label: Calendar date
description: YYYY-MM-DD.
author: matalog

name: datetime_text
label: Date and time text
description: MM-DD-YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY followed by a clock time.
author: matalog

name: windows_path
label: Windows path
description: Drive, UNC or NT device path with backslashes.
author: matalog

name: posix_path
label: POSIX path
description: Absolute path with forward slashes and no blanks.
author: matalog

name: filename
label: File name
description: Base name with an alphabetic extension of one to eight characters.
author: matalog

name: process_name
label: Process name
description: Executable file name with a program extension.
author: matalog

name: command_line
label: Command line
description: A quoted or path-like program, or a program name with an extension, followed by arguments; or a bare name followed by an option.
author: matalog

name: pid
label: Process id
description: Positive integer below ten million in a process id, parent process id or thread id field.
author: matalog

name: http_method
label: HTTP method
description: Request method.
author: matalog

name: http_status
label: HTTP status code
description: Three digits 100 to 599 in a status or response code field.
author: matalog

name: user_agent
label: User agent
description: Product/version or product (comment) token at the start, as browsers and HTTP clients send it.
author: matalog

name: boolean_text
label: Boolean text
description: true/false, yes/no, t/f, y/n, on/off; 0/1 stays integer text.
author: matalog

name: severity_word
label: Severity word
description: Log level or severity names.
author: matalog

name: action_word
label: Action word
description: Allowed/blocked, success/failure and similar outcome and verdict words.
author: matalog

name: outcome_word
label: Outcome word
description: Success or failure of an operation.
author: matalog

name: direction_word
label: Direction word
description: Traffic or event direction.
author: matalog

name: protocol_name
label: Protocol name
description: Transport and application protocol names.
author: matalog

name: country_code_iso2
label: Country code
description: Two upper-case letters, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 shape.
author: matalog

name: latitude
label: Latitude
description: Decimal degrees -90 to 90 with at least four fraction digits.
author: matalog

name: longitude
label: Longitude
description: Decimal degrees -180 to 180 with at least four fraction digits.
author: matalog

name: json_text
label: JSON text
description: An object or array literal.
author: matalog

name: base64_text
label: Base64 text
description: Base64 alphabet in groups of four, at least sixteen characters, optional padding.
author: matalog

name: hex_text
label: Hex text
description: Six or more hex digits with at least one letter, optional 0x prefix.
author: matalog

name: integer_text
label: Integer text
description: Optional sign and decimal digits.
author: matalog

name: float_text
label: Float text
description: Decimal number with an optional fraction or exponent.
author: matalog

name: percent
label: Percent
description: Number followed by a percent sign.
author: matalog
